queries.result: Turkish-language discovery identified TKGM's official Parsel Sorgu, Zonguldak Municipality's CBS portal, and municipal imar/parselasyon documents. The documents evidence planning/parcels and the portal shell evidences a GIS site, but no accessible anonymous parcel-vector schema, CRS, or stable ID-plus-geometry response was qualified.

officialSourceAssessment.nationalCustodian: Tapu ve Kadastro Genel Müdürlüğü (TKGM) is the national cadastral authority and its official Parsel Sorgu viewer advertises online parcel queries; this is national-agency evidence, not proof of a Zonguldak-local registry endpoint.
officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Zonguldak Belediyesi official CBS portal was identified, but its parcel service coverage and public vector endpoint were not verified.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: No Zonguldak-local public registry/map procedure or anonymous parcel-vector service was qualified. Municipal planning documents mention parcels and parcelation but are not a cadastral data service. Therefore registryFound remains null.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official TKGM search result states that Parsel Sorgu provides online parcel queries. The result did not expose a Zonguldak-specific service schema or safe vector response.

The public viewer shell was retrieved and referenced main.js?v=76.3 with GET/POST CORS headers, but fetching the JavaScript/API configuration was blocked by local certificate-chain verification failure. No TLS verification bypass or certificate exception was used; no parcel request was issued.

Official Zonguldak Municipality CBS portal was identified, but anonymous GET failed local TLS certificate verification. No login was attempted, no CAPTCHA/Cloudflare was bypassed, and no claim of service absence was made.

Official municipal documents page exposes imar-plan, parcelation and distribution documents naming Zonguldak neighbourhood parcels. These are planning notices/documents, not a public cadastral parcel-vector API, and no geometry was retained.

Official national GIS agency page describes cadastral data as a national geographic-data theme and points to municipal city guides, but it did not expose a Zonguldak parcel endpoint in this bounded review.
